line_or_section: header line 3 'Draft of 2026-10-18'; CI data job step 'Proposal regenerates from the result files'
finding: The CI data job fails at HEAD: regenerating the ATRC proposal changes the committed file. build_proposal.py stamps the date of the last commit of PROPOSAL_ATRC_body.md, which af26ead moved to 2026-10-20, but the committed output was generated before that commit and still says 2026-10-18. Any future body edit committed together with its output repeats the failure.
evidence: Fresh clone in scratch: python3 scripts/build_proposal.py; git diff shows only '-Draft of 2026-10-18' '+Draft of 2026-10-20'. build_proposal.py line 89 uses git log -1 --format=%cs -- docs/PROPOSAL_ATRC_body.md. All other data job steps regenerate cleanly.
suggested_fix: Regenerate and commit PROPOSAL_ATRC.md in a separate commit after the body commit, or stamp a date stored in the body file instead of a git date.
